summary: ARCHON REBUILT FOR S2: M+ 40 letters (25 moves) + score/popularity merged; raid pages S2 but empty. Mythicstats rolled to MID2. Aug-18 live hotfixes logged. 0 consensus moves.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 181-329 KB, parsed from the tier-list table rows (first <td> = the tier letter; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally, which is what keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable): raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and the per-page counts were printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6 roster shape before merging. ZERO tier moves against stored, raid and M+ alike - consistent with the page dates, which are byte-identical to last night's (raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16) and agree 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json, so nothing upstream rebuilt since the 08-18 S2 re-cut. Era read from each page's own title AND body, never a substring count: five titles self-identify as Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and the raid-HEALER page again carries a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a Season-2 body (21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) - body over title, per the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six; no seasonVerified value changed for this source, so it contributes nothing for freeze-season.mjs to do. Snapshots 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-19.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 158/161 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 unmatched, no duplicate spec+bracket, ZERO tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks rather than 4 - the extra set is the dungeon-difficulty list, rejected by ROSTER MATCH (9 non-roster labels failed to map) and never by position. Era from each page's own BODY: raid "how each spec ranks for Raiding content in the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" (Last Updated 10th August 2026), M+ "how different specs rank ... in Midnight Season 2" with Tactyks' byline naming Season 2 (Last Updated 13th August 2026). WORTH KNOWING FOR THE NEXT RUN: the pages' <meta description> boilerplate still reads "The War Within Season 3" on both - it is stale site chrome that contradicts the rendered body, so an era check reading the meta tag would wrongly drop both pages from the consensus. seasonVerified stays s2 on both; nothing to freeze. Method carries no published field by convention and none was invented. Snapshots 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-19.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-337 KB. Parsed by unescaping \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] - never by anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml(, since the raid-healer page carries a decoy call - with tolerant whitespace on [tier-label ...]X [/tier-label] and the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug as the identifier: 27/7/6 raid + 27/7/6 M+ = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, exactly one tier-list block per page. ZERO tier moves. Era: all six titles and their in-body headings read "for Midnight Season 2"; seasonVerified stays s2, nothing to freeze. published re-read per page and NOT carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-14 (unchanged), raid healer 2026-08-18 (was 08-17), raid tank 08-14 (unchanged), M+ DPS 2026-08-18 (was 08-15), M+ healer 2026-08-18 (was 08-17), M+ tank 2026-08-18 (was 08-17) - agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Four pages therefore re-dated themselves on Season-2 launch day while publishing identical letters, which is the honest reading: a rebuild that changed no ranking. Snapshots 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-19.

ARCHON HAS REBUILT FOR SEASON 2, and the two brackets are in different states. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 48-68 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, taking metric "throughput" for raid and "score" for M+ (never the default popularity grouping) and resolving every entry from its icon "Class-Spec" token with tiers[].entries read as a list OF LISTS. M+: the three pages now describe Season 2 (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, Kings' Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena in the encounter selector; scores 2663-2726 against last week's 3396-4256 S1 numbers; 88,280 + 29,405 + 29,435 parses behind them), so seasonVerified went s1 -> s2 on all three and 40/40 letters merged with 25 tier moves - the largest being Arcane Mage C->S, Devastation Evoker C->S, Blood DK C->S and Fury Warrior A->C, i.e. a genuine week-one S2 re-cut, not a parse artifact. RAID: those three pages have ALSO rebuilt to Season 2 ("DPS Tier List for Mythic The Venomous Abyss", the 9 S2 bosses in the selector) but publish NOTHING - totalParses 0 and all three tierLists (popularity/throughput/survivability) empty - because Mythic Venomous Abyss opened hours ago. Their seasonVerified was therefore left at s1 DELIBERATELY, and this is the one judgement call in tonight's run: the field gates whether the stored letters feed the live-season consensus, the stored archon raid letters are still the S1 cut, and flipping them to s2 would average S1 opinion into the S2 raid consensus. Nulling those 40 letters instead was rejected because it breaches the archon-tiers row floor (80 -> 40 against min 60) and the 25% row-drop guard, neither of which has an agent-side ack path. OWNER FLAG: when Archon's raid tier list populates, re-verify those three pages to s2 in the same run that merges the new letters. NOTE the whole-source consequence, which is why this is partial and why the consensus did not move: sourceSeasonOk reads EVERY page of a bracket, and archon's M+ bracket still contains the per-dungeon encounter page at s1, so Archon remains dark in both brackets' consensus - the documented mid-rebuild refusal working as designed. Snapshots on the 6 aggregate pages 2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-19; the 3 labelled pages were left at 2026-08-18 because nothing landed from them.

NOT REFRESHED, and the stored data was deliberately left byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 S1 bosses + 8 S1 dungeons, asOf 2026-08-17, top-level season stamp "s1"). Three findings, each verified rather than assumed. (1) The two registered per-encounter URLs (.../raid/mythic/imperator and .../mythic-plus/10/windrunner-spire/this-week) now return HTTP 200 with NO page object in __NEXT_DATA__ at all - Archon retired the Season 1 encounters when it rebuilt, so every stored encounter name is dead upstream. (2) Probing the S2 replacements: a Season-2 M+ dungeon page (altar-of-fangs) returns a healthy 27-row DPS score tier list, but a Season-2 raid boss page (nekzali-the-soulcoiler) returns totalParses 0 and empty tier lists for all three metrics, same as the aggregate raid pages. (3) A full S2 rewrite is therefore structurally blocked tonight and was not attempted: 8 dungeons x 40 specs = at most 320 tier rows with the raid side contributing zero, which is below the archon-encounters row floor of 440 AND a 48% drop against the committed 619, breaching maxRowDropPct 0.25. Both are hard publish-gate errors with no agent-writable ack channel, so the honest move is to leave the S1 file standing and say so. It is not currently misleading anyone: the file's season stamp is s1, liveSeason is s2, and the UI hides the whole Fight selector on exactly that mismatch (the guard added 2026-08-19). OWNER DECISION NEEDED: rebuilding this lane for Season 2 needs a reviewed change to the archon-encounters floor in required-sources.json (a CODEOWNERS file) - either lower the floor to a dungeons-only reality of ~320, or wait until Venomous Abyss accumulates enough parses that Archon publishes per-boss tiers and the raid side contributes again. Until then this row stays partial and the page snapshot stays 2026-08-18, so the 10-day staleness gate will make the lag visible on its own.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY tonight (0 entries) along with throughput and popularity - the Season-2 raid rebuild described in the archon-tiers row, with totalParses 0. Nothing to merge, so the 40 stored survivability tiers are unchanged at their 2026-08-17 asOf and the labelled page snapshot was deliberately not bumped to today: bumping it would restart a 10-day staleness clock on data that did not refresh, and letting that gate fire around 2026-08-28 is the true signal if Archon's raid cut stays empty. Note last night's re-cut (Blood DK / Brewmaster / Vengeance B->A, Protection Paladin C->A) is the last real state of this series and remains what is published.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could not be refreshed: props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data is EMPTY on all three Season-2 raid pages (0 rows, totalParses 0), which is the same rebuild-with-no-data state as the raid tier lists rather than a parse failure - the recipe was proven on the same run against the M+ pages, where the identical path returned 27/7/6 rows with score, popularity and parses. The 33 stored rows (27 DPS + 6 tank) are byte-identical and keep their 2026-08-16 asOf; nothing was restamped with today. This series will only return when Mythic Venomous Abyss logging accumulates, and it will then be Season-2 raid DPS replacing Season-1 raid DPS under the same season-agnostic metric name - worth a value-move check on the night it lands.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in exactly the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule: the Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection carries 0 rows (totalParses 0), so none of the 7 stored HPS values could be refreshed. All 7 unchanged at 2026-08-16, nothing merged, no date restamped.

"M+ score (95th pct)" refreshed in full from the three Season-2 M+ pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] - NOT the tierList structure, which carries only letters: 27 + 7 + 6 = 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, floats rounded to the stored integer precision, each row's `parses` carried through as n (88,280 / 29,405 / 29,435 across the three cuts). This is the Season-2 re-base: the whole series drops from 3396-4256 to 2663-2726 as scores reset with the new season, a family median move of 3748 -> 2710 (-27.7%) and a worst single row of -36.6% (Augmentation Evoker 4256 -> 2699), both inside maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35 and maxValueMovePct 0.6, so it lands without needing an ack - checked BEFORE merging, not after. asOf is Archon's own lastUpdated 2026-08-18T12:00:00Z, never the run date; the eight-day freeze reported since 2026-08-10 is over because Season 1 keys stopped being played and Season 2 keys have now opened.

Half the series refreshed and half could not. The 40 M+ rows were re-parsed from the Season-2 pages and merged at Archon's own 2026-08-18, shape-checked BEFORE the merge exactly as the recipe requires: every value a plausible percentage (0.4-42.1), the three M+ role groups summing to 99.8 / 100.1 / 99.9, and no row equal to that spec's own 95th-pct DPS - the check that catches the DPS-column-under-a-%-unit failure. The 40 RAID rows could not be refreshed at all, because the Season-2 raid pages publish an empty specRankingsSection (see archon-metrics), so they stay untouched at 2026-08-16, which is what the requirement's coverage date correctly reports. Partial rather than success for that reason. The M+ moves are large per row (a Season-2 popularity re-shuffle) but every value sits far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate does not - and should not - see them.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers/proxy/auth (the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched). manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two agree, so unlike the 08-04 case there is no movement hidden behind a pinned manifest; the rankings file was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest date. Selected by WHITELIST (categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField === "lowerBound" + keyRange === undefined, never a "not dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 name-matched with no mapping table. All 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11, never today. Upstream has now not run a pipeline for 8 days - it last ran the day 12.1 shipped - so this sits exactly on the contract's 8-day threshold and will go red tomorrow if wowmeta does not run for Season 2. That red would be accurate.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not touch warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. Read from wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-19T10:58:12Z, this run) which reports verdict "rdps-broken" - OAuth and GraphQL are healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent) but characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error", so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream; separately the HTML statistics transport has been Cloudflare-challenged since 2026-08-10 from residential IPs too, and the two are independent facts. evidence.landed carries no entry for wcl-live-raid, so the zone-53 (The Venomous Abyss, Mythic) medians could not land and the 47 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded in the requirement's own label: no S2 fetch path exists, the staleness alarm firing at 10 days IS the intended signal, and it clears when a zone-53 recipe lands - not by acking it away.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - "rdps-broken", attemptedAt 2026-08-19T10:58:12Z, transport healthy, metric family 500ing - and evidence.landed has no entry for wcl-live-mplus, so the zone-55 (Mythic+ Season 2) medians could not land and the 40 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. Owner-accepted standing red, per the requirement label; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands in src/fetch-wcl.mjs, which is an owner decision and not an agent one.

All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB, 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks - the parse is healthy and this is a DATA decision, not a failure. TWO THINGS CHANGED TONIGHT AND BOTH STRENGTHEN THE OWNER CASE: the pages have flipped their own titles to "Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2" (they read Season 1 as recently as last night) with a self-reported update stamp of 2026-08-19T03:00:43Z, and the SEVEN literal zeros that blocked the last three nights are GONE - every spec now carries a real ceiling. So the series is now a coherent Season-2 cut rather than a half-reset one. It still cannot be merged: all 40 values moved and the family median falls 4008 -> 2292, a 42.8% move against maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35 (the worst single row is Augmentation Evoker 4260 -> 1772, 58.4%, which squeaks under the 60% per-row limit - it is the FAMILY guard that blocks tonight, not the row guard). Merging the subset that moved least would publish a mixed-date pool under one series name, so the merge was held back WHOLESALE and stored data left byte-identical at 2026-08-15, per the standing rule that a correction big enough to trip the value-move guard is held back rather than worked around. OWNER DECISION, now well evidenced: re-run with value_move_ack (or land it in a reviewed local run) to adopt the Season-2 re-base of "Top-50 avg M+ rating (ceiling)" in one step. Note the 5-day staleness gate fires on this series tomorrow.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 5 attempts each. 17 specs now return real data - up from 14 last night, so the Season-2 re-sim is progressing - and 10 still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body persistently (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury); that body was retried rather than treated as structural, per the Beast Mastery precedent. Every one of the 17 carries simc_settings.tier "MID2" (read off each chart, never hard-coded - it moves each season) with chart timestamps of 2026-08-19, while the 26 stored profiles are MID1-era. MERGED NOTHING, per the sim-tier uniformity gate: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so a 17-of-27 merge would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Adopt a new tier wholesale or not at all. simc_settings.ptr was compared explicitly against the STRING "0". fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHARTS' own 2026-07-08 / 07-15 - 42 days stale - and the heartbeat stays red, which is the true signal that upstream has not finished re-simming. FOR THE OWNER: when the last 10 specs land, the wholesale adoption will itself need a value_move_ack, since MID2-vs-MID1 moves most sim rows well past the 60% per-row limit.

Both transports fetched, HTTP 200. MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block - its header reads SimulationCraft 1210-01 for 12.1.0.69382 Live (hotfix 2026-08-18/69382, git build HEAD b4248732a8), which has moved again from last night's 8a83cb502a, so the Season-2 re-sim is still churning. Fell back to MID1_Raid.html per the recipe: it is UNCHANGED - SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, git build 678e66d384, its own timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33 - and was re-parsed anyway by taking the "data":[...] array enclosing the FIRST big-value MID1_ hit (a fixed byte window after "series" reads the later burst/DTPS charts at 2.2-2.5x inflation) and mapping profile names by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed: 49 profiles -> 26 DPS specs, all 26 byte-identical to stored; the 9 unmapped names are tank profiles, excluded by design. Nothing merged - an unchanged build hash is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse, and the era check was read off the header build string, not the visible "12.3.0" Highcharts version. No MID2_Raid report exists yet (both .txt and .html 404). At 11 days the contract's 10-day gate is already firing on this, correctly.

The weekly roll finally happened and it rolled straight into Season 2. https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1077, HTTP 200: "Period 1077, week 1 of MID2" (Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile), replacing the period 1075 / MID1 window that had been frozen for five runs - period 1076 was skipped upstream. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon blocks) with lowercase-hyphenated labels normalised on [-\s]+: 40 rows, 0 unmatched. Verified it is the representation SHARE and not the /meta per-key-PRESENCE column before merging - series sum 100.1%, max row 9.0, no zeros - and all 40 values moved, which is what a new season's first period looks like (Arcane Mage 0.2 -> 9.0, Devourer DH 14.1 -> 3.3). Every value is far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate correctly does not see them. HONEST CAVEAT ON THE NAME: the series is stored as "Top-2000 keys representation", and this period is still in progress - the page says "Top 999 keys, 4994 characters (4227 unique), 8.4 average key level" - so tonight's share is measured over a smaller and still-growing key pool than the name implies. asOf 2026-08-19: the page publishes no date of its own and the period is live, so the run date is the honest stamp here (unlike wowmeta and bloodmallet, which do publish one).

Four channels swept, and one substantial entry landed. (1) Dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42:09Z, newest still Linxy #19 - the 12.1 PTR cycle is closed, so a quiet thread is the expected state, not a lost thread. (2) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block: 40 items, newest 2026-08-18 22:30 CDT. (3) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) because it leads RSS within a run - it tops out at the same id 382513, so the two agree and nothing landed mid-run. (4) Blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, newest 2026-08-18 20:54. LOGGED: a new kind:"hotfix" entry dated 2026-08-18 for Blizzard's Season-2 launch-day hotfixes, verified against the canonical forum topic 2336376 ("World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - August 18") rather than only the Wowhead mirror, and cited via wowheadUrl news=382516 because a hotfix has no post in the tracked thread. Its PvE class section is mostly the SHIPPED form of the 2026-08-15 "Class Tuning Incoming" pass already in the feed - all 15 specs compared line by line and found identical in effect and value - so those lines were deliberately NOT restated, because the outlook tally counts LINES and restating them would count the same tuning twice (the same reason the launch patch notes are excluded from it). What IS new and logged: Elemental Shaman, absent from the 08-15 pass, gains +5% all damage alongside a Venomous Abyss 4-piece bug fix, so its spec.tierSet asOf/source advanced to the 08-18 hotfix with a dated note on the 4-set - the tier-set upkeep gate's requirement; plus bug-fix and mechanical lines for Blood DK, Subtlety Rogue, Demonology, Affliction, Destruction, Protection Warrior and the Hellcaller tree, none of which classify as a direction (verified against classifyHighlight: only the Elemental line votes, as a buff). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED and stated in the entry label: the whole PvP section - note Fire Mage's Venomous Abyss 4-piece change there is explicitly scoped "in PvP combat", so its PvE set is unchanged and spec.tierSet was NOT touched - plus the dungeon/delve/item/profession sections and a cosmetic tamed-Hydra size change. Also swept and correctly not logged: "Coiled Altar Massively Nerfed" and "Venomcursed Ula'tek Neck Tuning" (encounter and item, not class) and Kaivax's 2026-08-12 "Season 2 Class Tuning Plans", which was read in full and is a roadmap with no per-spec tuning line. NOTE FOR WHOEVER READS THE COVERAGE NUMBERS: recomputed rather than quoted, 1 spec sits at ptr:null (Demonology Warlock, the deliberate null), and expertRead now returns null for all 40 specs in BOTH brackets - not lost takes, but by construction, since it gates on PHASES.ptr and the 12.1 PTR phase ended at the flip. The expert lane is dormant between cycles and returns when a 12.2 PTR entry is added to PHASES; the coverage paragraph in CLAUDE.md is written in the PTR-cycle voice and reads as alarming here.

Discovery complete, distillation impossible - 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added, and no `latest` field advanced. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0, because data/pending-transcripts.json was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran, so there was nothing for it to drain and no transcript exists to distil from. No transcript was fetched from YouTube or any API by this agent, and nothing was installed or upgraded. 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff (79 creator entries share them), 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries diffed against a 1096-id seen-set built from the four STRUCTURED lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never a regex over log prose. 66 unseen, all in-cycle against the 2026-06-18 bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, not builds[0]) - launch week produces a lot of uploads. TWO QUEUED under the nightly's keyword filter and the fetch-broadly/queue-narrowly rule that protects Supadata's 100-request MONTHLY budget: Dratnos 38bYF2buWg0 "Race to World First Day 1 Recap - A Tough Start" (registered Warrior specialist, day-one raid analysis in the bracket that carries the least evidence) and Shindigg W40Mcpr1kLg "12.1 Rogue Guide (All changes)" (his own class, a changes walkthrough rather than a route or BiS guide). NOTHING was retired to seen[]: no dismissal tonight is durable. The other 64 stay UNSEEN and were counted rather than estimated: 24 stream/Twitch shells and live-launch broadcasts (which cannot carry captions yet and must be left for the VOD), 21 dungeon-route, boss, delve, gearing, BiS and spec how-to guides (all named in the standing rule that guide-shaped content carries no spec-strength read, and 4 of them are Tactyks' M+ content, which is separately firewalled because he writes the Method M+ list), 8 PvP-framed uploads (Supatease x5 including "Nine WORST Specs 12.1", which the 08-09 precedent records as PvP-reasoned, and Dalaran Gaming's three duels videos), 6 raid-boss PoV clips whose descriptions are nothing but a Twitch link and a log url, 4 shorts/off-topic, and NeekapHere's "This Week In WoW" news round-up, left unseen on the 08-18 precedent. media:description was parsed alongside every title and settled most of that triage at zero transcript cost.
